animation_cannot_replace.en: Animated exports are downloadable files and cannot replace the source video.
animation_cannot_replace.zh: 动图为下载文件，不能替换原视频

asset_in_use.en: This asset is used by a task, edit history or preset and cannot be deleted.
asset_in_use.zh: 字幕被任务、历史或预设引用，不能删除

asset_invalid.en: An editing asset is invalid, missing or has changed.
asset_invalid.zh: 编辑素材无效、丢失或已变化

audio_asset_file_missing.en: The audio asset file is missing.

audio_asset_not_found.en: This audio asset no longer exists.

audio_format_unsupported.en: Choose an MP3, WAV, M4A, AAC, FLAC or OGG audio file.
audio_format_unsupported.zh: 请选择 MP3、WAV、M4A、AAC、FLAC、OGG 等音频文件

audio_too_large.zh: 音频文件不能超过 {{max_mb}} MiB

audio_track_missing.en: This file has no audio track.

authentication_required.en: Sign in again; your session has expired.

batch_multi_source_unsupported.en: Multi-source operations cannot be applied independently to each video.
batch_multi_source_unsupported.zh: 多源操作不能用于每视频独立批处理

bookmark_limit.en: A video can have at most 1,000 bookmarks and manual chapters.
bookmark_limit.zh: 每个视频最多保存 1000 个书签与手动章节

bookmark_time_invalid.en: Bookmarks cannot be after the video ends; chapters must start before its end.
bookmark_time_invalid.zh: 书签时间不能超过视频时长，章节须在结尾之前

bundled_font_missing.en: The bundled Chinese font is missing.

collection_conflict.en: The collection name is taken or its contents changed. Refresh and try again.
collection_conflict.zh: 同名合集已存在或合集内容已变化，请刷新后重试

collection_name_conflict.en: A collection with this name already exists.

collection_order_changed.en: Include all visible collection members in the order. Refresh and try again.
collection_order_changed.zh: 排序必须包含全部当前可见成员，请刷新后重试

collection_videos_missing.en: Some selected videos are missing or have been deleted.
collection_videos_missing.zh: 部分视频不存在或已删除

composite_must_save_as.en: Save a multi-source composite as a new video.
composite_must_save_as.zh: 多源拼接必须另存为新视频

composite_source_required.en: Include the current video in the composite inputs.
composite_source_required.zh: 当前视频必须包含在拼接输入中

conflict.en: The resource has changed. Refresh and try again.
conflict.zh: 资源已变化，请刷新后重试

cover_image_invalid.en: This image file cannot be recognized.

csrf_header_missing.en: The required X-Requested-With header is missing.

derived_file_not_found.en: This derived video resource is unavailable.

derived_file_pending.en: This file has not been generated yet.

encoder_unavailable.en: This FFmpeg build does not include the selected hardware encoder.
encoder_unavailable.zh: 当前 ffmpeg 未编译该硬件编码器

filter_range_invalid.en: The minimum filter value cannot exceed the maximum.
filter_range_invalid.zh: 筛选范围的下限不能超过上限

folder_cycle.en: A folder cannot be moved into itself or one of its descendants.
folder_cycle.zh: 不能移动到自身或子文件夹

folder_name_conflict.en: A folder with this name already exists.

forbidden.en: You do not have permission for this action.

history_missing.en: This video has no edit history that can be replayed.
history_missing.zh: 该视频没有可重新生成的编辑记录

history_source_unavailable.en: Cannot replay edits: source “{{title}}” is unavailable.
history_source_unavailable.zh: 无法重新生成：源视频「{{title}}」不可用

hls_below_threshold.en: This video is below the automatic HLS size threshold.
hls_below_threshold.zh: 此视频未达到自动生成大小阈值

hls_busy.en: Finish or cancel the HLS generation task before clearing its cache.
hls_busy.zh: 请先结束或取消 HLS 生成任务，再清理缓存

hls_cache_limit.en: The HLS cache limit would be exceeded. Clear the cache or increase the limit.
hls_cache_limit.zh: HLS 缓存将超过上限，请清理缓存或增加上限

hls_cache_not_found.en: No HLS cache is available for this video.

hls_disabled.en: HLS is disabled. Enable it in settings.
hls_disabled.zh: HLS 已关闭，请先在设置中开启

hls_source_changed.en: The source file has changed. Generate HLS again.
hls_source_changed.zh: 源文件已变化，请重新生成 HLS

image_asset_not_found.en: This image asset no longer exists.

image_format_unsupported.en: Choose a static PNG, JPEG or WebP image.
image_format_unsupported.zh: 请选择 PNG、JPEG 或静态 WebP 图片

image_unreadable.en: Cannot read this image. Use a static PNG, JPEG or WebP file.

import_directory_inside_data.en: The import directory cannot be inside the ReelVault data directory.
import_directory_inside_data.zh: 导入目录不能位于 ReelVault 数据目录内

import_directory_unavailable.en: No usable import directory is configured.
import_directory_unavailable.zh: 未配置可用的导入目录 REELVAULT_IMPORT_DIR

import_failed.en: Cannot import from this directory. Check its configuration.
import_failed.zh: 无法从该目录导入，请检查配置

insufficient_storage.en: There is not enough free disk space.

internal_error.en: The server could not complete the request.

job_download_unavailable.en: This task has no downloadable output.
job_download_unavailable.zh: 该任务没有可下载的文件

job_file_removed.en: This output file has been removed.

job_output_already_saved.en: This task already saved its output. View the result to avoid duplicate changes.
job_output_already_saved.zh: 该任务已保存输出，请查看结果，避免重复修改

job_pause_conflict.en: This task cannot be paused in its current state.
job_pause_conflict.zh: 当前任务状态无法暂停

job_priority_locked.en: Only tasks that have not started can change priority.
job_priority_locked.zh: 只能调整尚未启动的任务优先级

job_resume_conflict.en: This task cannot be resumed in its current state.
job_resume_conflict.zh: 当前任务状态无法继续

job_retry_pending.en: This task already has an unfinished retry.
job_retry_pending.zh: 该任务已有未结束的重试

job_retry_requires_failure.en: Only failed tasks can be retried.
job_retry_requires_failure.zh: 只有失败任务可以重试

job_retry_unsupported.en: This task type does not support retry.
job_retry_unsupported.zh: 此任务类型不支持重试

login_rate_limited.en: Too many failed sign-ins. Try again in {{minutes}} minutes.
login_rate_limited.zh: 登录失败次数过多，请 {{minutes}} 分钟后再试

lut_asset_not_found.en: This LUT asset no longer exists.

lut_ffmpeg_unreadable.en: This FFmpeg build cannot read the LUT.
lut_ffmpeg_unreadable.zh: 当前 FFmpeg 无法读取该 LUT

lut_format_unsupported.en: Choose a 1D or 3D LUT in .cube format.
lut_format_unsupported.zh: 请选择 .cube 格式的 1D 或 3D LUT

method_not_allowed.en: This request method is not allowed.

not_found.en: The requested resource was not found.

payload_too_large.en: The uploaded file is too large.

preset_name_conflict.en: A preset with this name already exists.

rate_limited.en: Too many requests. Try again later.
rate_limited.zh: 请求过于频繁，请稍后重试

scene_detection_busy.en: Finish or cancel the existing scene detection before changing its parameters.
scene_detection_busy.zh: 已有未结束的场景检测，请完成或取消后调整参数

source_file_unavailable.en: The source video file is unavailable.

source_video_not_found.en: The source video is missing or has been deleted.
source_video_not_found.zh: 源视频不存在或已删除

subtitle_already_attached.en: These subtitles are already attached to this video.
subtitle_already_attached.zh: 这份字幕已添加到视频

subtitle_asset_invalid.en: The subtitle asset is invalid or unavailable.
subtitle_asset_invalid.zh: 字幕素材无效或不可用

subtitle_asset_not_found.en: This subtitle asset no longer exists.

subtitle_conversion_failed.en: Cannot convert these subtitles. Check the file and FFmpeg.
subtitle_conversion_failed.zh: 字幕无法转换，请检查文件与 FFmpeg

subtitle_encoding_invalid.en: Choose the correct subtitle character encoding.
subtitle_encoding_invalid.zh: 字幕编码不匹配，请选择正确编码

subtitle_format_unsupported.en: Choose an SRT, ASS or VTT subtitle file.
subtitle_format_unsupported.zh: 请选择 SRT、ASS 或 VTT 字幕

subtitle_image_not_text.en: Image subtitles cannot be converted to text. Use subtitle burn-in instead.
subtitle_image_not_text.zh: 图像字幕无法转换为文本，可选择烧录

subtitle_invalid.en: This subtitle file has no valid cues or cannot be parsed.
subtitle_invalid.zh: 字幕没有有效片段或无法解析

subtitle_still_attached.en: Remove this subtitle track from its videos before deleting it.
subtitle_still_attached.zh: 字幕仍挂在视频上，请先移除轨道

subtitle_track_not_found.en: This subtitle track no longer exists.

subtitle_tracks_unreadable.en: Cannot read the video subtitle tracks.
subtitle_tracks_unreadable.zh: 无法读取视频字幕轨道

upgrade_conflict.en: The upgrade cannot start. Check deployment settings and active tasks.
upgrade_conflict.zh: 无法开始升级，请检查部署设置与运行中任务

upload_folder_deleted.en: The destination folder was deleted. Cancel and choose another location.
upload_folder_deleted.zh: 目标文件夹已删除，请取消并重新选择上传位置

upload_incomplete.en: The file has not finished uploading.

upload_offset_mismatch.en: The upload offset does not match. Resume from byte {{received}}.
upload_offset_mismatch.zh: 偏移量不匹配，请从 {{received}} 字节继续

upload_size_exceeded.en: The uploaded data exceeds the declared file size.

validation_error.en: The request contains invalid values. Check the form and try again.
validation_error.zh: 请求包含无效参数，请检查表单后重试

video_format_unsupported.en: This video format is not supported.

video_not_ready.en: The video is still processing. Wait until it is ready.

video_version_changed.en: The video has changed. Refresh the page.
video_version_changed.zh: 视频版本已变化，请刷新

tag_group_name_conflict.en: A tag group with this name already exists.

tag_name_conflict.zh: 同名标签已存在，请选择其他名称或合并标签
tag_name_conflict.en: A tag with this name already exists. Choose another name or merge the tags.

tag_self_merge.zh: 不能将标签合并到自身
tag_self_merge.en: A tag cannot be merged into itself.
